data.long_description:
Provident Estate is proud to present this exceptional 5-bedroom townhouse in the vibrant community of DAMAC Hills 2.


  Offering generous living spaces, modern finishes, and a family-friendly lifestyle, this stunning G+2 mid-terraced home is ideal for large families seeking comfort, convenience, and excellent community amenities.

Property Features:

 5 Spacious Bedrooms
 4 Modern Bathrooms
 Bright Living and Dining Areas
 Family Room
 Entrance Hall
 Storage Room
 Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
 Built-in Wardrobes
 Elegant Chandelier
 Landscaped Private Garden
 Large Decked Terrace
 Built-Up Area: 2,450 Sq. Ft.
 Private Covered Parking 
 Access to Community Swimming Pool

Community Highlights:

  Residents enjoy access to a wide range of world-class amenities, including:


 Fully Equipped Gym
 Swimming Pools
 Tennis & Squash Courts
 Basketball Court
 Cricket Field
 Outdoor Gym
 Outdoor Cinema
 Water Town Attractions
 Waterside Café
 Restaurants & Supermarket
 Saudi German Clinic
 Petting Farm
 Green Zones & Landscaped Gardens
 Picnic Parks & BBQ Areas
 Daily Complimentary Shuttle Bus Service

Prime Location

  DAMAC Hills 2 offers the perfect balance between tranquility and connectivity. Located just 25 minutes from central Dubai, the community enjoys seamless access via Al Qudra Road and major highway networks, ensuring easy travel to key destinations across the city.


  Whether you're looking for your next family home or a spacious property in one of Dubai's most sought-after communities, this residence presents an outstanding opportunity.


  Contact Provident Estate today to arrange your private viewing.
